def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); cells=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    r0=min(r for r,c,v in cells); r1=max(r for r,c,v in cells)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c,v in cells:
        nc=c-(r1-r)
        if 0<=nc<w: out[r][nc]=v
    return out
